messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired PD-5229 — Autoscaler queue backlog > 95% for inference-cell-eu-west-1. Estimated backlog: 24k requests.

pagerduty-bot: PD-5229 assigned to maria. Escalation policy: autoscale-fallback -> infra-sre.

maria: acked. I'm on it. initial triage: autoscaler controller shows healthy API, but node provisioning lagging and KV cache hits dropped to ~2%.

ashwin: saw a spike in cold-starts around 04:12 UTC, lots of new pod boot logs, then failed warmup hook on several nodes. Could be kvcache warmup race.

leo: confirming — kvcache-controller logs show repeated evict/restore churn. snippet:
```
I0315 04:12:10 kvcache.go:214] restore shard 3 -> warmed=true
I0315 04:12:11 kvcache.go:260] eviction triggered, mem_pressure=0.92
I0315 04:12:12 provisioner.go:98] node-alloc fail: quota-exhausted
I0315 04:12:13 autoscaler.go:401] desired=120 -> created=4 (rate limit)
```

sophie: customer-side symptoms: increased generation latency and a handful of 503s from hosted API (routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat). Pagerduty alert included customer impact tag: partial-degradation.

maria: immediate mitigations I'm rolling: 1) disable strict kvcache eviction to preserve prefixes, 2) trigger manual warm pool bump for inference-cell-eu-west-1 (+8 reserved nodes), 3) enable fallback routing to smaller quantized model for non-enterprise tenants. Doing them one-by-one to watch effect.

ashwin: +1 on controlled change. How long to spin nodes? current provider queue shows 2–6m, but warmup hooks add ~30–45s. If we add reserved nodes we can reduce cold-starts.

maria: running command to bump reserved pool:
```bash
# manual reserved +8 for eu-west-1 cell
redwoodctl cell update inference-cell-eu-west-1 --reserved-nodes +8 --reason "emergency backlog PD-5229"
```

incident-bot: Action recorded: reserved pool update started by maria.

leo: while that ramps, I'm toggling autoscaler rate limit to allow faster creations (temp):
```yaml
autoscaler:
  create_rate_limit: 20/s # was 5/s
  burst: 40
```
Applying now.

sophie: seeing preliminary improvement on client metrics: queue length falling from 24k -> ~14k after manual bump and rate tweak. p50 latency still elevated but trending down.

maria: good. leaving fallback routing on for low-tier traffic to relieve hotpath. I'll keep enterprise tenants pinned.

ashwin: note — kvcache restore race still suspicious. opening a follow-up issue for persistent fix: ensure kvcache warmup happens before traffic routes to new pods (pre-warm gating).

oncall-bot: PD-5229 acknowledgment recorded. Current status: acknowledged -> in-progress. Next escalation window in 18m if no resolution.

leo: for transparency, adding a quick dashboard snapshot link: https://console.redwood/inference/cells/eu-west-1/backlog (shared).

maria: action items now: (a) continue reserved bump + monitor, (b) watch kvcache metrics (hit%, restore duration), (c) keep fallback routing until p50 < 300ms and queue < 2k, (d) contact infra if provider quotas hit.

sophie: I'm notifying Customer Success for impacted customers on the enterprise list and opening a support ticket template.

ashwin: if provider quota is the blocker we'll escalate to infra-sre to unblock (they can temporarily increase our fleet quota with partner ops).

maria: I'll update PD incident notes and mark mitigation steps. Will call for handoff to morning oncall if still active at 06:00 UTC.

leo: small follow-up — add a short-lived circuit-breaker so that extremely long inference requests get early 429s, preventing runaway KV cache pressure. Coordinating with API-frontend to apply 10s hard timeout for non-priority routes.

incident-bot: PD-5229 status updated: mitigation in progress, impact: partial-degradation, next check-in in 10m.

sophie: thanks team. current metrics: backlog 1) 04:20 UTC = 14.3k 2) 04:28 UTC = 6.1k 3) 04:36 UTC = 1.9k. p50 latency for /v1/generate: 04:36 UTC = 280ms.

maria: rolling postmortem stub created: https://docs.redwood/incidents/PD-5229-draft. We'll collect timeline + root cause (kvcache warmup + provider rate limit + autoscaler rate cap).

ashwin: logging follow-ups: add better signal for kvcache-restore-duration and a boolean pre-warm-ready metric.

leo: thanks. I'll keep the autoscaler create_rate_limit change as temporary for 30m and then revert if stable.

maria: handing off to morning oncall (ashwin) in 30m. I'll leave notes on PD. Good recovery so far, leaving fallback in place until we confirm heatmap clear. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: maria -> ashwin at 05:00 UTC.

sophie: closing customer-facing comms draft and will update when we fully clear.

maria: final: if anyone sees new regressions ping @infra or @platform immediately.

leo: ack. I'll follow up with a short RFC on pre-warm gating for kvcache.

incident-bot: PD-5229 closed automatically by pager duty after mitigation notes added (status: resolved) — timeline exported.

maria: thanks all, excellent quick coordination. We'll do full postmortem and remediation plan tomorrow. :heart:
